results.title: India in winning position against Sri Lanka
results.description: India put itself in a winning position in the second cricket test on Wednesday by restricting Sri Lanka in its second innings after enforcing the follow on.

results.title: New $20 Polymarket referral code “OREGON” launches for PGA Tour Championship
results.description: The Polymarket referral code OREGON has launched for the PGA Tour Championship, which tees off Thursday — a $20 bonus on a $10 deposit, with the first-round-leader and Top 20 boards live now.

results.title: Royals' 9-game winning streak ends after being shut out by the Blue Jays
results.description: The Royals failed to tie what would've been their longest win streak since 2014.

results.title: Arizona safety Quinn Olson ‘could be the next Treydan Stukes story’
results.description: Arizona safety Quinn Olson “could be the next Treydan Stukes story at Arizona in terms of a walk-on turning into a really good player.”

results.title: Triple gold for Sampath, Ramdatt at Keshav Trading Central Zone Juniors
results.description: Trent Sampath and Ishta Ramdatt emerged as the top players at the Keshav Trading Ltd Central Zone Summer Junior Tournament, held at the Cunupia Crew Table Tennis Club, Chadee Trace, Cunupia, recently.

results.title: Area Briefs: SU women's soccer fifth in ODAC poll
results.description: The Shenandoah University women's soccer team was picked fifth in the Old Dominion Athletic Conference preseason coaches poll on Wednesday, its highest ranking since 2017.

results.title: Michael Jordan 'will NOT return to NBC' after underwhelming stint in lucrative NBA analyst role
results.description: Rather than provide regular analysis and insight, Jordan conducted just one interview with NBC host Mike Tirico, which was spread across multiple weeks of the season.
